column1: # TEEGRIS_4 constructs memrefs with uint32_t lengths at offsets 8/24;
# the upper four bytes are padding, not part of the length. TEEGRIS_5
# reads size_t lengths. Zero-extend the authoritative old lengths at the
# two shared-memory checks and command dispatch. Keep both checks active.
# The PLT add x16 is unused after the required DT_BIND_NOW adaptation;
# PLT resolver padding is unreachable and holds the command-width shim.
1|0x30eb8|10c23e91|e203022a|TEES_IsREESharedMemory PLT|zero-extend old uint32_t memory length before the real stock check
1|0x30a04|1f2003d51f2003d51f2003d5|e103012ae303032a7375ff17|command width adapter|zero-extend input/output lengths and tail-call original dispatch at VMA 0xefd8
